plotSections.title: Leaving the spectral door behind
bullets: Dana is absent and lacks investigative spells such as detect magic, so the party skips waiting to study the door.
The party resumes travel, pretending nothing happened.
The fake spectral door continues following Gerk, staying near him as he moves and fixed on the ship when it sails.
Gerk tries waving, verbal commands, closed sesame, and a performance check totaling 17 to dismiss it; nothing works.
Sylan tells Gerk he may keep experimenting but must not open another door until they reach land.

plotSections.title: Walker’s empty pockets
bullets: Walker has only about fourteen hundred gold on hand—826 gold and 61 platinum—while roughly ten thousand gold sits unused back in Langdale.
He goes to the Haven Hold dragon Hanzuni hoping for charity, a loan, or an affordable magical item.

plotSections.title: Haven Hold and Hanzuni
bullets: Walker enters Haven Hold’s hoard hall: a lively arched market with a treasure mountain on a central floating island separated by an empty moat.
Throwing a gauntlet into the hoard triggers a Sunder Chase; the hoard’s magic keeps treasure from falling away.
Hanzuni is an ancient copper dragon, relatively small for his age, with polished copper scales; he swims through his hoard.
He greets Glimmen first, remembers her as a hatchling, and has forgotten Walker’s name.
Glimmen eagerly dives into the hoard to swim with him.

plotSections.title: Quaylin’s history
bullets: Hanzuni confirms Quaylin of Quaylin’s Quax and says Quaylin has won two Sunder Chases.
Quaylin was not always a duck-fowl; a magical beak heirloom transmutes the wearer and grants great potion knowledge.
The neck heirloom is his prize from his second Sunder Chase win; the beak relates to his first.
Quaylin arrived in Sunder after his race on a small vessel with nothing but potion craft to his name.

plotSections.title: Walker’s request
bullets: Walker tells Hanzuni that Quaylin sent him and asks for help with terrible exhaustion he has been suffering lately.

chronologicalEvents: The party skips Dana’s door investigation because she is absent and lacks detect magic.
Travel resumes; the spectral door follows Gerk and stays fixed on the ship.
Gerk fails to dismiss the door through physical, verbal, and performance attempts.
Sylan forbids opening new doors until landfall.
Walker notes most of his wealth is back in Langdale and approaches Hanzuni at Haven Hold.
Hanzuni swims in his hoard and invites Glimmen to swim rather than addressing Walker first.
Glimmen dives into the hoard; Hanzuni recognizes her as a grown dragon with a rider.
Walker reintroduces himself and asks after Quaylin.
Hanzuni reveals Quaylin’s Sunder Chase wins and magical beak backstory.
Walker asks Hanzuni for something to help with his worsening exhaustion.
